subject: SparkBridge vendor activation — invoice lane & payment window coordination
messages:
From: Elliot Mason <elliot.mason@sparkbridge.io>
To: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.example>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@sparkbridge.io>, SaaSOps Legal <legal@sparkbridge.io>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SparkBridge vendor activation — preferred payment window question

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the quick onboarding outline earlier. We're ready to get SparkBridge set up in your vendor portal. A couple of items to confirm before we finish our side:

- Our standard is Net 30, but for this initial engagement we were hoping to align to Net 45 to match our internal receivables calendar. Is Redwood able to accept Net 45 for the first 90 days, then revert to Net 30?
- We have an early-pay program on our side where we can offer a 1.5% discount for payment inside 10 business days if Redwood is open to an expedited lane. Would Redwood consider offering an early-pay enrollment for the first invoice?

We can attach the signed PO once terms are confirmed. I can also fill your vendor form if you send it over.

Appreciate it — looking to go live next week.

Best,
Elliot Mason
Head of Finance Ops
SparkBridge

---
Elliot Mason
SparkBridge | elliot.mason@sparkbridge.io
From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.example>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SparkBridge vendor activation — preferred payment window question

Hi Elliot —

Thanks — happy to get this moving. Short answers up front: yes, we can onboard you on Net 45 for the first 90 days as a temporary exception, and yes, we have an early-pay enrollment program that we can use for an expedited first invoice (there's a nominal fee). A couple of next steps to make this operational:

1) Please complete the attached Redwood vendor onboarding form (PDF) and return with your W-9 and signed PO.
2) Confirm the PO number you plan to submit and which invoice you want expedited (first invoice only, or ongoing?).
3) We need a formal approval from Finance for the temporary Net 45 exception — I've looped in Vivek and Marissa to approve the 90-day window.

I'll outline the practical flow below so finance can sign off quickly:
- Onboard vendor record with Net 30 as default.
- Apply a payment override to Net 45 for the vendor record, effective immediately, with an automatic rollback to Net 30 on 2027-01-13 (90 days).
- For the early-pay lane, Finance will need to approve enrollment and confirm the fee structure; accounting will route the first invoice to the early-pay queue on receipt.

Attaching the vendor form now.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>

Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SparkBridge vendor activation — preferred payment window question

Camila / Vivek — forwarding SparkBridge's ask. My thoughts: Net 45 for 90 days is acceptable for a strategic partner as long as we: (a) require the signed PO and W-9 before any exception is applied; (b) set up a short-term escrow hold or approval gate on the first invoice to ensure deliverable acceptance before payment; (c) require the vendor to accept the early-pay enrollment terms (we typically pass through a ~2% fee to cover accelerated settlement).

Vivek — do you approve a temporary Net 45 exception + the early-pay fee for this account? If so, can Accounting flag the vendor record and implement the rollback date?

- Marissa

Subject: Re: SparkBridge vendor activation — preferred payment window question

Marissa / Camila — approved with conditions. Summary of finance stance:

- Approve temporary Net 45 exception for 90 days, subject to: signed PO on file and completed onboarding packet.
- Early-pay enrollment: Accounting can support an expedited first invoice if SparkBridge agrees to a 2% early-pay fee for 10-day settlement. We won't absorb the fee for third-party vendors.
- Escrow/hold: we'll implement an acceptance-based hold on the first invoice for up to 7 business days; payment will be released after confirmation of milestone acceptance.

Operational items for camila/team:
- Create vendor record with Net 30 default.
- Add vendor note: "Net45-90d-exception; revert 2027-01-13."
- Create early-pay queue tag on vendor record and notify Accounting when invoice arrives.

Camila — you can confirm with Elliot and once we have signed PO + W-9 I'll ask Accounting to flag the account and stand up the early-pay lane.

-Vivek

Vivek Kulkarni
